outcome: Visceral adipose tissue mRNA expression of insulin signaling genes (PI3KCA, PI3KR1, IRS1, IRS2)
cohort: 42 women (20 with GDM and 22 with normal glucose tolerance) undergoing planned cesarean section.
finding: Women with GDM had significantly decreased expression of PI3KR1 in visceral fat compared to women with normal glucose tolerance, but this was not associated with altered promoter methylation.
